objects.name: Operation AkaiRyū
objects.description: [Operation AkaiRyū](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0060) (Japanese for RedDragon) was a cyberespionage spearphishing campaign conducted by [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) between June and September 2024 against entities in Japan and Central Europe. [Operation AkaiRyū](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0060) notably included the first reported targeting of a European entity by [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054), as well as their use of [UPPERCUT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0275), which was thought to be exclusive to [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045).(Citation: ESET MirrorFace 2025)(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Kasha Anel NOV 2024)

objects.description_fa: [Operation AkaiRyū](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0060) (به ژاپنی RedDragon) یک کمپین spearphishing جاسوسی سایبری بود که توسط [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) بین ژوئن و سپتامبر 2024 و در اروپای مرکزی انجام شد. [عملیات AkaiRyū](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0060) به ویژه شامل اولین مورد هدف قرار دادن یک نهاد اروپایی توسط [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) و همچنین استفاده آنها از [UPPERCUT]([[[CTI_PRESERVE_6] انحصاری بود]) بود.
